Description: Coil spring (circular wire, mean radius 10, wire radius 2, z from -2 to 26) and a sphere of radius 11 around (0,0,12). The sphere clearly overlaps the wire: the wire occupies the radial band 8..12 and the sphere reaches radius 11 in the plane z=12.
Expected: V(union) + V(intersect) = V(coil) + V(sphere) = 2368.705 + 5575.280 = 7943.985, with 0 < V(intersect) < 2368.705.
Status: FIXED (re-checked 2026-08-10). V(union)=7208.1880, V(intersect)=735.7382, V(coil minus ball)=1632.9238 against V(coil)=2368.6613 and V(ball)=5575.2798: both identities hold to about 2e-6 relative. Keep as a regression guard.
Actual (before the fix): Failed, with a symptom that depended on the orientation the helical extrusion happened to produce (see HelicalExtrudeOrientationUnstable.json). With a POSITIVE coil no overlap was detected at all and every operation returned one of the operands unchanged; with a NEGATIVE coil the union threw 'Sequence contains no elements'. A coaxial cylinder of radius 9 showed the same signature and additionally needed about 340 s.
